text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear priorities. Start by breaking a big task into smaller steps and setting a realistic schedule. Not every task is equally important, so focus on the most urgent work first. Scope management is also essential: if the project is too large, agree with others on what can be reduced or postponed. Finally, communication matters. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until the deadline. By planning carefully, prioritizing tasks, controlling the scope, and keeping people informed, you can meet deadlines with less stress.
